## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- Precondition for DD2: establishes the RED test that Task 2b must make GREEN

## Implementation

File: tests/scripts/test-ci-generator.sh (modify — add new test function)

Add test_mode_pr_protected_generates_resolve_fetch_step:
- Given: ci-generator.sh invoked with --mode=pr-protected on a temp dir with a minimal suite config
- When: generator runs
- Then: output CI workflow YAML (a) contains a step with "Resolve" and "fetch" and "DSO plugin" in its name/description, AND (b) contains `validate-required-checks.sh` inside a `run:` YAML block (grep -A2 'validate-required-checks' <file> | grep -q 'run:')

Test must FAIL before Task 2b is implemented (--mode=pr-protected does not exist yet).

Also update .test-index with RED marker (space before bracket required):
  plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/ci-generator.sh [test_mode_pr_protected_generates_resolve_fetch_step]

## TDD Requirement
This IS the RED test task. The test is the deliverable. After writing it, confirm it FAILS.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] test_mode_pr_protected_generates_resolve_fetch_step function present
  Verify: grep -q 'test_mode_pr_protected_generates_resolve_fetch_step' tests/scripts/test-ci-generator.sh
- [ ] Test correctly FAILS before Task 2b implementation (RED confirmed)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-ci-generator.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'FAIL.*test_mode_pr_protected'
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker (space before bracket)
  Verify: grep -q 'ci-generator\.sh \[test_mode_pr_protected' .test-index
- [ ] Unit tests pass (other tests still pass)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-ci-generator.sh 2>&1 | grep -qE 'PASS.*[0-9]'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet->opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
